sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM deals_enriched 
WHERE deal_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'

SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount_usd
FROM deals_enriched
WHERE deal_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'

SELECT seller_broker AS broker, COUNT(*) AS trade_count
FROM deals_enriched
GROUP BY seller_broker
ORDER BY trade_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT "Наименование"
FROM participants
WHERE "ИНН" = '917899526'

SELECT SUM(volume_units) AS total_hemp_sold
FROM deals_enriched
WHERE deal_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
  AND product_name ILIKE 'хлопково%'

SELECT AVG(price_per_unit) AS average_price_per_unit
FROM deals_enriched
WHERE product_name ILIKE 'хлопок%'

SELECT 
    region, 
    COUNT(*) AS deal_count
FROM 
    deals_enriched
GROUP BY 
    region
ORDER BY 
    deal_count DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT deal_id, deal_date, amount_uzs, product_name, unit, lot_size, qty_lots, volume_units, price_per_unit
FROM deals_enriched
ORDER BY amount_uzs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    seller_inn, 
    buyer_inn, 
    product_name, 
    SUM(volume_units) AS total_volume, 
    SUM(amount_uzs) AS total_amount_uzs
FROM 
    deals_enriched
WHERE 
    seller_inn IS NOT NULL 
    AND product_name ILIKE '%eng%ko%'
GROUP BY 
    seller_inn, 
    buyer_inn, 
    product_name
ORDER BY 
    total_amount_uzs DESC

SELECT SUM(volume_units) AS total_wheat_tons
FROM deals_enriched
WHERE deal_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  AND product_name ILIKE 'пшениц%'

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS paid_deals_count,
    SUM(amount_uzs) AS total_amount_uzs
FROM 
    deals_enriched
WHERE 
    paid_date >= '2023-01-01' AND paid_date < '2024-01-01'

SELECT 
    deal_id, 
    deal_date, 
    auction_type, 
    SUM(volume_units) AS total_volume_units, 
    SUM(amount_uzs) AS total_amount_uzs, 
    AVG(price_per_unit) AS average_price_per_unit
FROM 
    deals_enriched
WHERE 
    region ILIKE 'Namangan viloyati' 
    AND product_name ILIKE 'цемент%'
GROUP BY 
    deal_id, 
    deal_date, 
    auction_type

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM deals_enriched
WHERE product_name ILIKE 'мук%' OR product_name ILIKE 'пшениц%'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM deals_enriched
WHERE deal_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  AND status ILIKE 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)'

SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_export_amount_usd
FROM deals_enriched
WHERE contract_type ILIKE 'Экспортный' AND currency = 'Доллар США'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM deals_enriched 
WHERE deal_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'

SELECT SUM(amount_uzs) AS total_amount_uzs
FROM deals_enriched
WHERE deal_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND status ILIKE 'Исполнен'

SELECT AVG(de.price_per_unit) AS avg_price_per_kg_uzs
FROM deals_enriched de
JOIN usd_rates ur ON de.deal_date = ur.rate_date
WHERE de.product_name ILIKE 'хлопково%' 
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM de.deal_date) = 2023 
  AND de.unit = 'килограмм'
  AND de.contract_type = 'Внутренний'
  AND de.contract_form = 'Спот'

SELECT 
    buyer_inn, 
    buyer_broker, 
    SUM(volume_units) AS total_volume, 
    SUM(amount_uzs) AS total_amount_uzs
FROM 
    deals_enriched
WHERE 
    region = 'Toshkent shahri'
GROUP BY 
    buyer_inn, 
    buyer_broker
ORDER BY 
    total_volume DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(delivered_lots - qty_lots) AS недопоставленные_lотов
FROM deals_enriched
WHERE status ILIKE 'Исполнен(Частично)'

SELECT rate_date, uzs_per_usd
FROM usd_rates
WHERE rate_date = '2024-03-15'

SELECT 
    deal_id, 
    seller_inn, 
    buyer_inn, 
    deal_date 
FROM 
    deals_enriched 
WHERE 
    seller_inn = buyer_inn

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM deals_enriched
WHERE deal_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
AND product_name ILIKE '%золото%'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM deals_enriched 
WHERE deal_date BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2026-11-30'

SELECT "Наименование", "Регион", "Вид деятельности"
FROM participants
WHERE "ИНН" = '123456789'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM deals_enriched 
WHERE buyer_broker = 'BK999'
SELECT 'NO_DATA'
SELECT 'NO_DATA'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM deals_enriched 
WHERE deal_date BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-12-31'

SELECT 
    100 * SUM(CASE WHEN deal_date >= '2020-01-01' AND deal_date < '2021-01-01' THEN amount_uzs / lot_size - start_price END) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN deal_date >= '2019-01-01' AND deal_date < '2020-01-01' THEN amount_uzs / lot_size END) AS price_increase_percentage
FROM 
    deals_enriched
WHERE 
    deal_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2020-12-31' AND 
    currency = 'Доллар США' AND 
    product_name IS NOT NULL
